services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U \"$$POSTGRES_USER\" -d \"$$POSTGRES_DB\""]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      acts-repository-network:
      repository-database-network:
        aliases:
          - acts-repository-postgres

  basex:
    image: ghcr.io/basexdb/basex:13.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      BASEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${BASEX_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - basex-data:/opt/basex/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      - acts-repository-network
      - repository-database-network

  garage:
    image: dxflrs/garage:v2.5.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["/garage", "server", "--single-node", "--default-bucket"]
    environment:
      GARAGE_RPC_SECRET: ${GARAGE_RPC_SECRET}
      GARAGE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_KEY: ${GARAGE_ACCESS_KEY}
      GARAGE_DEFAULT_SECRET_KEY: ${GARAGE_SECRET_KEY}
      GARAGE_DEFAULT_BUCKET: ${GARAGE_ATTACHMENTS_BUCKET:-legal-acts-attachments}
    configs:
      - source: garage-config
        target: /etc/garage.toml
    volumes:
      - garage-data:/var/lib/garage
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/garage", "status"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      - acts-repository-network

  acts-repository-api:
    image: ${DEPLOY_IMAGE}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      ConnectionStrings__Postgres: >-
        Host=postgres;Port=5432;Database=${POSTGRES_DB};
        Username=${POSTGRES_USER};Password=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      Modules__Api__Enabled: ${API_ENABLED:-true}
      Modules__Import__Enabled: ${IMPORT_ENABLED:-false}
      Import__QueueBaseUrl: ${IMPORT_QUEUE_BASE_URL:-}
      Import__QueueName: ${IMPORT_QUEUE_NAME:-}
      Import__Worker: ${IMPORT_WORKER:-repository-import}
      Import__LeaseSeconds: ${IMPORT_LEASE_SECONDS:-900}
      Import__PollIntervalSeconds: ${IMPORT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-5}
      ExchangeFileStore__ServiceUrl: ${EXCHANGE_SERVICE_URL:-}
      ExchangeFileStore__Bucket: ${EXCHANGE_BUCKET:-}
      ExchangeFileStore__AccessKey: ${EXCHANGE_ACCESS_KEY:-}
      ExchangeFileStore__SecretKey: ${EXCHANGE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      ExchangeFileStore__Region: ${EXCHANGE_REGION:-us-east-1}
      FilesStore__ServiceUrl: http://garage:3900
      FilesStore__AttachmentsBucket: ${GARAGE_ATTACHMENTS_BUCKET:-legal-acts-attachments}
      FilesStore__ActsBucket: ${GARAGE_ACTS_BUCKET:-legal-acts}
      FilesStore__AccessKey: ${GARAGE_ACCESS_KEY}
      FilesStore__SecretKey: ${GARAGE_SECRET_KEY}
      FilesStore__Region: garage
      BaseX__BaseUrl: http://basex:8080
      BaseX__Database: ${BASEX_DB}
      BaseX__User: ${BASEX_USER:-admin}
      BaseX__Password: ${BASEX_PASSWORD}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      basex:
        condition: service_healthy
      garage:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz || exit 1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.docker.network=proxy
      - traefik.http.routers.acts-repository.rule=PathPrefix(`/acts-repository`)
      - traefik.http.routers.acts-repository.entrypoints=web
      - traefik.http.routers.acts-repository.priority=100
      - traefik.http.middlewares.acts-repository-strip.stripprefix.prefixes=/acts-repository
      - traefik.http.routers.acts-repository.middlewares=acts-repository-strip
      - traefik.http.services.acts-repository.loadbalancer.server.port=8080
    networks:
      - acts-repository-network
      - proxy

configs:
  garage-config:
    content: |
      metadata_dir = "/var/lib/garage/meta"
      data_dir = "/var/lib/garage/data"
      db_engine = "sqlite"

      replication_factor = 1

      rpc_bind_addr = "[::]:3901"
      rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"

      [s3_api]
      s3_region = "garage"
      api_bind_addr = "[::]:3900"
      root_domain = ".s3.garage.localhost"

      [admin]
      api_bind_addr = "[::]:3903"

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  basex-data:
  garage-data:

networks:
  acts-repository-network:
    internal: true
  proxy:
    external: true
  repository-database-network:
    external: true
